notes.title: Dominique Pamplemousse returns in musical sequel
notes.content: In going back through our articles about Dominique Pamplemousse in order to inform this article about the sequel (THERE IS A SEQUEL TO DOMINIQUE PAMPLEMOUSSE [Itch.io page] – flagging it up in case I end up burying the lede), I found Alec had coined the term “Claymation Noir” for the game and thought that was pretty much perfect. Good work, Alec of the past! … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Dominique Pamplemousse
notes.content:
Dominique Pamplemousse is Now Available on Steam!
Dominique Pamplemousse in “It’s All Over Once The Fat Lady Sings!” is a unique and offbeat stop motion animated detective adventure game about gender and the economy. Also, all the characters frequently burst into song.

Nominated for four awards at the IGF Awards 2014: Excellence in Narrative, Excellence in Audio, the Nuovo Award and the Seumas McNally Grand Prize.
